en.plugins.reminder.desc: Set a reminder (30s, 10m, 2h, 1d, 3j, 14:30...), list or cancel them
en.plugins.reminder.usage:
{0}remind <when> <text> - set a reminder
{0}remind list - your pending reminders
{0}remind cancel <id> - cancel a reminder

*When:* 30s, 10m, 2h, 1d, 3j (days), 1h30m, 14:30 (next occurrence) or 2026-12-31 18:00.
Example: {0}remind 2h Call the dentist
en.plugins.reminder.no_text: ❌ Add the text of the reminder after the time.
en.plugins.reminder.limit_reached: ❌ You already have {0} pending reminders, which is the maximum. Wait for one to fire or cancel one with {1}remind cancel <id>.
en.plugins.reminder.text_too_long: ❌ This reminder is too long (maximum {0} characters).
en.plugins.reminder.too_soon: ❌ The time must be at least 5 seconds from now.
en.plugins.reminder.too_far: ❌ The time must be within one year from now.
en.plugins.reminder.none: You have no pending reminders in this chat.
en.plugins.reminder.none_all: There are no pending reminders in this chat.
en.plugins.reminder.not_found: ❌ No pending reminder with the id {0}.
en.plugins.reminder.cancel_denied: 🔒 Only the creator, a group admin or a bot owner can cancel this reminder.
en.plugins.reminder.missed: ⚠️ {0} of your reminders could not be delivered because the bot was offline for too long:

fr.plugins.reminder.desc: Programmer un rappel (30s, 10m, 2h, 1d, 3j, 14:30...), les lister ou les annuler
fr.plugins.reminder.usage:
{0}remind <quand> <texte> - programmer un rappel
{0}remind list - vos rappels en attente
{0}remind cancel <id> - annuler un rappel

*Quand :* 30s, 10m, 2h, 1d, 3j (jours), 1h30m, 14:30 (prochaine occurrence) ou 2026-12-31 18:00.
Exemple : {0}remind 2h Appeler le dentiste
fr.plugins.reminder.no_text: ❌ Ajoutez le texte du rappel après l'heure.
fr.plugins.reminder.fire_delayed:
⏰ *Rappel* pour {0} _(envoyé en retard, il était prévu le {1})_

{2}
